cases.what: the starting values on a burst at sample 12000: opens over 480 samples, holds 1920, shuts over 10560
Attack 0: fully open on the burst's first sample
Hold 500 ms: open 24000 samples after the burst ends
Hold 0 and Release 5 ms: it dips at the burst's quiet zero crossings, and is shut 240 samples after the burst
Threshold -20 dB: the quiet burst (-26 dB) stays shut, the loud one (-6 dB) opens it
Threshold -60 dB: both bursts open it
Threshold keyed from -40 dB (frame 0) to -20 dB (frame 10) over a steady -28 dB: it shuts part-way through frame 6
the right channel's burst opens the gate for both: the quiet left is heard while it is open
frames 10 to 19 of fx_gate_001 alone: the same samples as the whole mix there
a layer starting at frame 6 with a level of -6 dB: the gate counts from the layer's start, before the level
the gate switched off: the sound unchanged
Attack keyed from 0 ms (frame 0) to 100 ms (frame 10) at 29.97: the ramp lengthens sample by sample
two gates in a row: the second opens on what the first lets through
a Threshold of +3 dB, outside -60 to 0: kept, EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID, the sound unchanged

refused.what: a picture effect (Exposure) on an audio layer is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID
Noise Gate on a solid layer is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID
an expression on a Noise Gate number is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: sound effects take keys only
a Mix on Noise Gate is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: a sound effect has no Mix

unknown.what: an effect this build does not know on an audio layer: kept and saved as written, EFFECT_UNSUPPORTED, the sound unchanged
